competitors.name: Speechify

pricing.freeTier: Free plan: max 1.5x speed, 10 robotic sounding voices, text-to-speech features only; 3-day trial for Premium reported by users (credit card required).
pricing.notes: Rendered speechify.com/pricing shows $29/Month; page data lists yearly $139. Google Play IAP range observed: $0.49-$139.99 per item. Reviewers report an extra library add-on (~$25) and per-book purchases (Inferred).

tts.notes: Voices include celebrity-licensed voices (Gwyneth Paltrow, Snoop Dogg) per Play description. Premium gate covers natural voices, Scan & Listen, AI features.

extraction.engine: OCR scan (camera/screenshot) + cloud TTS; text highlighting during playback
extraction.notes: Reviewers say the OCR reads only the pages photographed, not a whole book from a cover photo.

library.library: yes (free tier capped at ~5 saved files per reviews)

playback.notes: Play page does not document background/media-session behavior; users describe listening while doing other things.

ux.notes: Voice AI Assistant chat, AI podcasts, voice-typing keyboard, Scan & Listen.

privacy.dataCollection: Play Data safety: data encrypted in transit; no data shared with third parties; deletion requests supported (self-reported).

strengths: Largest brand and cross-platform footprint (10M+ Android installs; claims 50M+ users)
1,000+ voices, 60+ languages, celebrity voices
OCR camera input plus AI assistant/dictation beyond TTS
Cross-device library sync and integrations with Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive
weaknesses: Aggressive upselling and cancellation friction
Per-page OCR sold as scan-a-cover in ads
Paragraph skipping and wrong highlight position
No one-time purchase option; premium features removed from lower tiers

complaints: Misleading OCR marketing: 'you have to scan each individual page of my book' (1-star, 2026-09-12)

Cancellation friction: 'This app makes it nearly impossible to cancel your subscription!' (1-star, 2026-09-12)
Paywall creep: 'They locked every single normal sounding voice behind a pay wall' (1-star, 2026-07-23)
Extra costs: 'Pay for a subscription. Pay for library access. Pay for books, too.' (1-star, 2026-07-10)
